source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: At least one NDCA-certified Scrutineer must officiate; a back-up Scrutineer is required when only one is engaged; scrutineer levels S1-S3 are awarded on an NDCA exam and an S1 may work only alongside an S2 or S3.

requirement: Body role assignable only with a verified credential; never the generic scorer.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6B): attestation record and credential records, surfaced through _compoc_blockers_qualifications. Not built.
interpretation_notes: No scrutineer concept exists today. The Skating System algorithm is a separate unresolved gap (registry known gaps). Design only (PR-A, section 6B): no credential model, no attestation table, no test; no compliance claimed. Organizer attestation never clears this requirement and is never shown as governing-body certification.
decision_refs: OD-15 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now, Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
